headline: President Clinton authorized calling members of the military's Selected Reserve to active duty.
what_it_does: This order lets the military order members of the Selected Reserve to full-time active duty. The Selected Reserve includes part-time reservists and National Guard members who train regularly and can be called up when needed. The title does not say how many people could be called, for how long, or for what mission.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the Selected Reserve and National Guard
who_it_affects.how: They could be ordered to leave their civilian lives and serve on full-time active duty.

who_it_affects.group: Families and civilian employers of reservists
who_it_affects.how: They could lose the reservist's presence at home or at work while that person serves on active duty.
